description: This irrelevant family fixture bounds observation sharing under strict alignment (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text $c:candidate %conditions $c.without-elision.matches(rival)
%rule candidate {X [+T]} B
%rule rival {piece} B
%rule piece m | n
%rule m X [+T]
%rule n X [+T]
%rule fam z
%rule z Z [+V]
